scope: Current native production sources and resources, current official Apple documentation, and unauthenticated read-only checks of the configured public policy/support URLs. No personal archive, real clipboard, installed application, standard preference domain, permission prompt, notification delivery, or upload was used.
limitations: Source review and automated tests cannot guarantee App Store approval.

The exact App Store distribution-signed binary must still be tested for sandbox access, folder permission revocation, notification permission behavior, clean installation, and current supported macOS versions.
Final coordinated Release source QA passed 73 of 73 suites, including 37 privacy information checks. This is not exact App Store distribution-binary verification.

The docs-only privacy renderer passed eleven assertions, but its bottom-scroll candidates failed visual QA and are withheld in rejected/. The top/date fixtures passed; exact signed live policy scrolling remains pending. This exporter limitation is not an established production bug.
The public privacy policy still contains the older wording. Publishing the updated policy was not authorized or performed.
HTTP 200 for the support page does not prove that a real, maintained contact method is present.

requiredReasonAPIs.justification: Production preference keys store DaBin-only settings. System appearance is read through NSApp.effectiveAppearance, not another app's UserDefaults domain.
systemUptime measures elapsed time for an in-app animation. It is not transmitted off-device.

Preview-cache keys read modificationDate and creationDate of verified DaBin-owned original/preview files. CapturePreviewFileReference restricts production references to archive-owned paths; DailyArchive.safeURL and OriginalFileStorage.validateRegularFile enforce the boundary. Production CaptureStore uses sandbox Application Support/DaBin. No display-only or user-selected-external-file timestamp reason was added.

localCorrections.test: PrivacyInformationTests verifies FileTimestamp is exactly C617.1.
PrivacyInformationTests covers bundled date extraction, whitespace, CRLF, missing/empty dates, inline body mentions, and missing-resource fallback.
PrivacyInformationTests verifies visible project names and task words, acknowledgment without task completion, Quiet mode behavior, and non-guaranteed capture exclusion.

localCorrections.justification: The consent paragraph explicitly limits website-preview requests to manually saved links and says automatic links never fetch previews, matching PreviewService.

verifiedSourceBoundaries: App Sandbox is enabled; entitlements are limited to user-selected read/write files, app-scope bookmarks, and outbound network client.
No broad file, Screen Recording, Accessibility, camera, microphone, Contacts, Photos, Calendar, or location entitlement was found.

Auto Capture is off by default. Its shared hasAcknowledgedPrivacyExplanation gate shows a local-storage explanation on first activation, not on every subsequent switch. Clipboard and screenshot channels have separate switches; screenshot capture also requires explicit folder authorization.
Clipboard and screenshot-folder startup establish a baseline instead of importing existing content.
Screenshot grants use read-only security-scoped bookmarks, stale bookmarks are rejected, and acquired scope is balanced on shutdown/revocation.
Pause, Off, and channel generation guards stop monitoring and discard queued private snapshots.
Auto Capture has a persistent visible menu bar indication even when Quiet mode suppresses success animation.
Common password managers and DaBin itself are excluded by default; frontmost-app attribution is best effort, not a privacy guarantee.
Automatic links never initiate website previews; optional manual link previews default off and cancellation invalidates queued and active requests.
Notification permission is requested only for explicit reminder saves; reminder notification content is generic.
Focus timer signs reveal first-three-word task labels locally and do not request notification permission or complete the task.
Application shutdown stops automatic monitors, shortcuts, panels, preview requests, content indexing, and local focus sessions.
Targeted source scan found no private APIs, dynamic code loading, unrestricted event taps, or silent login/startup registration.

officialAppleSources.supports: Required-reason API category list, including modificationDate, creationDate, systemUptime, and UserDefaults.
C617.1 for app-container metadata, 35F9.1 for elapsed-time/timers, and CA92.1 for app-only preferences.
2.4.5 sandbox/Store distribution, 2.5.1 public APIs, 2.5.14 recording consent/indication, 5.1.1 accessible accurate policy and revocation, and 1.5 support contact.
